::: {#hero-heading}

PhD student in Economics at University College Dublin (UCD), funded by the UCD School of Economics.

## Background

I hold a Master's degree in Economics and Econometrics (LM(EC)^2, 110 cum laude) from the University of Bologna and a BSc (Hons) in International Economics and Trade from the University of Nottingham Ningbo China.

My research interests are labor economics and political economics, using both theoretical and empirical approaches.
